about: The award-winning interactive sci-fi thriller movie from the publishers of Five Dates, The Bunker, Bloodshore and Who Pressed Mute on Uncle Marcus.

After a major bio-weapon attack on London, two scientists find themselves in a locked-down laboratory with time, and air, running out. With interactive decision-based gameplay, your actions and your relationship with other characters will lead you to one of eight suspenseful endings.
+ From the writer of the Emmy award-winning writing team from The Handmaid’s Tale
+ Real-time Relationship Status Tracking that influences the story
+ Real-time Personality Trait Tracking that evolves based on your choices
+ Unlockable features include Skip Scene, Personality Assessment and a Hidden Event
+ Featuring a Pause Choices option for improved audience participation during live streams
+ Guest acting performance by livestreamer and presenter, Leahviathan.
+ Starring Michelle Mylett (Letterkenny) and Kate Dickie (Game of Thrones).
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
